description: For any of the 950+ sites in the takedown registry: the documented removal method (form, email, both, guide, or none), the opt-out URL and privacy email on record, the parent company that actually processes the request, sibling sites one request may cover, and a link to our step-by-step guide when one exists. Accepts a domain or a URL.

domain.description: Domain or URL on the site, e.g. spokeo.com or https://www.spokeo.com/...

name: get_removal_route
title: Get the documented removal route for a site
